# Architecture Spine

`spine.md` — the product's topology deep view, one of the two hand-written files in the architecture store at `.mochiko/product/architecture/`. It carries the container diagram, the element table (containers, boundaries and flows, each with a lifecycle status), the sequence diagrams for qualifying flows, and the as-built notes a landing fold writes. The concern catalog is its sibling file, `concerns.md`, and the repo-root `ARCHITECTURE.md` is a derived view of both — regenerated on every store write, never hand-edited. Authored per mochiko:authoring-architecture-store; diagram craft and altitude per mochiko:patterns-system-design.

## Header

Title "# Architecture Spine" plus the scope line naming the product shape the spine describes. Governs no heading of its own.

## Container diagram

One C4-container view as a mermaid block: the containers and how they communicate, with `proposed` and in-flight-class elements marked and `removed` elements not drawn. One diagram, not a gallery — a second view earns its place only where the first cannot carry it.

## Elements

The element table, one row per element: `SPN-XXX-<slug>` id · kind (container | boundary | flow) · name · one-line responsibility · what it talks to and in which style · lifecycle status (the value set and its run keys per mochiko:authoring-architecture-store). Two further columns, `Raised` (its cycle, cited behind its run's key in a code span — a joined FEAT or EPIC ID, or `lane-<slug>`: `` `FEAT-012-<slug>` C3-<slug> ``) and `Weighed` (its why, one line), are filled on a build-raised element and read `—` elsewhere. A `removed` element keeps its row, reduced to id, kind, name and status. One line per element; a row that needs a paragraph is hiding a concern row or a graduated file.

## Key flows

Sequence diagrams for the flows that qualify — selection and altitude per mochiko:patterns-system-design. A flow that reads off the container diagram does not qualify.

## As-built notes — optional

What the landing fold recorded about the built state where it differs from the approved shape — one line per element, id-keyed. Drift itself lives on the element's row; this section is the fold's own note.

## Conformance

Checked mechanically before the write lands. Each line is a string or a count, never a judgment.

- Required headings, in order: `## Container diagram`, `## Elements`, `## Key flows`
- An undeclared `##` heading is denied. `###` and deeper are yours.
- Line budgets, each counted from its `##` line to the next `##`, nested content included:
  - `## Container diagram` — 30 lines
  - `## Elements` — 40 lines
  - `## Key flows` — 30 lines
  - `## As-built notes` — 15 lines (optional)

## Skeleton

# Architecture Spine

**Scope**: backend-service

## Container diagram

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    [containers and their communication; proposed and in-flight-class elements marked; removed elements not drawn]
```

| SPN-002-<slug> | container | [name] | [one line] | SPN-003-<slug> (queue) | in-flight (FEAT-012-tenant-workspace-admin) | [`FEAT-012-tenant-workspace-admin` C<n>-<slug>] | [why, one line] |
| SPN-003-<slug> | boundary | [name] | [what changes across it — trust, ownership, tenancy] | — | ruled | — | — |
| SPN-004-<slug> | flow | [name] | — | — | removed | — | — |

[Sequence diagrams for qualifying flows — selection and altitude per mochiko:patterns-system-design.]
